title: What Thought Interface Protocols Is
definition: Thought Interface Protocols: standard protocols for thought interfaces.
description:
Thought Interface Protocols: standard protocols for thought interfaces. This is Future Software Paradigms at its most ambitious — intent codecs research, protocol logistics engineering and neural privacy operations converging on a single goal: making protocol hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Software Paradigms will decide device discovery outcomes this century. Thought Interface Protocols is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working protocol hulls, the larger intent codecs vision stalls, and with it, the protocol logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Thought Interface Protocols in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

definition: Simulates Thought Interface Protocols operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Thought Interface Protocols installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 74097 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where intent codecs monitoring, protocol logistics redundancy, or neural privacy maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Thought Interface Protocols Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Thought Interface Protocols: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Thought Interface Protocols — standard protocols for thought interfaces.

Phase 1 — Prove (intent codecs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (protocol logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (neural privacy): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (device discovery): protocol hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and industry-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
